Name: Lumisteria Short Flowery Grass
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod is a content pack for the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398]More Grass[/url]" Mod.
It adds a lot of short flowery grass in all seasons.

[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]


If you want a short effect and more density of flower, you can disable the use of default grass in the config.

This mod can be used with other More Grass packs, of course ! Some screenshots are showing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5416]this other More Grass[/url] pack :)
